items.briefing:
Australian organisations should be aware that home battery systems — increasingly common across the country — are now being flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern. If your organisation or staff connect personal energy storage devices to networks, this could create unexpected security risks worth discussing with your IT team.

Separately, AI tools continue to raise security questions for businesses. Both OpenAI and GitLab have recently added new controls to their AI platforms to improve safety and oversight — a reminder to review what AI tools your staff are using and ensure they are approved and properly configured.

**Tip:** Ask your IT team for a list of approved AI tools before using new ones for work tasks.

featured.title: OpenAI Adds Controls That Should've Been There Already
